name: Steve Barton

summary.text: Steve Barton is an attorney and former electronic engineer running for the State Board of Education in District 7. He holds degrees in biophysics, electrical engineering and computer science, law, and medicine.

experience.text: Career experience includes work as an electronic engineer and computer architect designing processor integrated circuits, and as a patent attorney.
J.D., Brigham Young University, 1994; M.D., St. George's University, 2007; graduate degree, University of California, Berkeley, 1975.

education_focus.text: Barton's top message is parental rights: he says 'parents and parental rights need to be respected in all schools' and that parents should be key stakeholders in curriculum and textbook selection.
On academic standards, he proposes integrating math instruction with science and business examples and says new teachers should be required to take math-based physical-science and business courses.
His campaign site says the 2022 State Social Studies Standards 'require leftist politics from preschool onward' and calls for the board to 'evict politics from schools.'

positions.quote: Boot the boys from girl's sports, as anyone who has ever experienced male puberty has advantages in strength, size, and speed over the XX population.

positions.note: Opposes Amendment 87 and Proposition NN by name, without qualification; he proposes a minimum education share of the state budget instead.
